items.name: EXPRESSO_CHURN_PREDICTION_APP
items.description: The Expresso Churn Prediction App is a machine learning-based web application designed to predict customer churn for Expresso, a telecommunications service provider in Africa. This project demonstrates proficiency in data preprocessing, machine learning model training, and deploying interactive web applications using Streamlit.

items.name: BODYBALANCE.AI
items.description: AI concierge for healthcare practices that converts website visitors into WhatsApp bookings.  Built with LangChain RAG + OpenAI GPT-4o-mini + Streamlit. Features emergency guardrails, structured medical outputs, and 24/7 patient support. Fork it for your clinic.

items.name: CONVERSATIONAL_AGENT_BUILDER
items.description: A public demo platform for building domain-specific AI chatbots (Sales & FAQ) using prompt-engineered agents, intent-aware responses, session-based analytics, and a web chat widget. Built with Next.js and OpenAI, deployed on Vercel.

items.name: fabric-diabetes-prediction
items.description: This project explores an end-to-end machine learning workflow using Microsoft Fabric. The dataset comes from Azure Open Datasets and includes various health indicators for diabetes prediction.

items.description: Text Analytics Demo on Azure App Service

items.description: This project demonstrates how AutoML can significantly improve fraud detection with minimal manual intervention

items.name: gen-ai-bootcamp-2025
items.description: This repository documents my 6-week journey through the Free GenAI Bootcamp, where I’m learning to design, build, and deploy real-world Generative AI applications. The bootcamp covers everything from prompt engineering and AI-powered assistants to advanced topics like training, optimization, and production deployment.

items.name: ELECTRIC_VEHICLE_TYPE_PREDICTION
items.description: This project uses Support Vector Machines (SVM) to predict electric vehicle prices based on features like make, model, range, and base MSRP. It includes data preprocessing, model training, and evaluation using performance metrics like MSE and R-squared. The model aims to enhance vehicle price prediction for market analysis and valuation.

items.name: 5G_ENERGY_CONSUMPTION_PREDICTION
items.description: This project aims to predict energy consumption in 5G base stations using Supervised Learning Regression techniques. The goal is to model and estimate the energy consumed by different 5G base stations based on various features such as load, transmitting power, and energy-saving methods.

items.name: CREDIT_CARD_CUSTOMER_SEGMENTATION
items.description: I applied clustering algorithms like K-Means and Hierarchical Clustering to group credit card users based on spending behavior, payment patterns, and credit limit. By identifying distinct customer segments, businesses can create targeted marketing strategies and improve customer retention.

items.name: BANKING_DATA_ANALYSIS_WITH_SQL_AND_POWER-BI
items.description: This project highlights my ability to manage data workflows, write efficient SQL queries, and create impactful visualizations. It reflects how data can drive decisions in the banking sector.

items.name: CLIMATE_DATA_ANALYSIS_AND_VISUALIZATION
items.description: The Climate Data Visualization and Analysis project showcases a comprehensive exploration of African climate data, with an emphasis on identifying patterns and trends in average temperatures across different countries and time periods. It serves as a practical demonstration of my data analysis, data visualization, and problem-solving skills.

items.name: BANK_MARKETING_CAMPAIGN_PREDICTION
items.description: This repository features a deep learning model that predicts customer term deposit subscriptions in a banking campaign. It includes scripts for data preprocessing, model training, evaluation, and visualizations, structured for clarity and reproducibility. Ideal for understanding customer behavior and optimizing marketing strategies.

items.name: FASHION_MNIST_CLASSIFIER
items.description: This project implements a neural network to classify fashion items from the Fashion MNIST dataset using Keras and TensorFlow. The web app allows users to upload images and receive predictions on the type of fashion item, such as shirts, trousers, and more.

items.name: FINANCIAL_INCLUSION_PREDICTION_APP
items.description: The Financial Inclusion Prediction project predicts bank account ownership among individuals in East Africa using demographic data. Built with Streamlit and powered by a Random Forest Classifier, the app provides instant predictions based on user inputs, addressing financial accessibility for approximately 33,600 individuals.

items.name: MICROSOFT_MALWARE_PREDICTION
items.description: With this project, I explored how machine learning can enhance malware detection and prediction. The insights gained from both supervised and unsupervised techniques can be used to develop more robust and accurate cybersecurity solutions.

items.name: NASA_API_EDA
items.description: This project demonstrates how to interact with NASA's public APIs to fetch and process data. The project illustrates skills in making API requests, handling JSON responses, and managing data processing with Python.

items.name: MARKET_BASKET_ANALYSIS
items.description: This project utilizes the Apriori algorithm to perform Market Basket Analysis, identifying frequent itemsets and association rules from customer purchase data. The goal is to uncover hidden patterns in shopping behavior, enabling supermarkets to optimize product placement, create targeted promotions, and improve sales strategies.

items.name: FINANCIAL_MODELLING
items.description: This project predicts financial crises in 13 African countries using machine learning. It leverages economic data (inflation, exchange rates, debt defaults) with models like Random Forest and SVM. Includes preprocessing, feature selection, and hyperparameter tuning.  Technologies: Python, Scikit-learn, Pandas, Matplotlib
